title: Enjoy Sports with Pokémon!
description: Pokémon and Trainers come together in the spirit of sports in Pokémon the Series.

media.title: The Flame Pokémon-athon!
media.description: Our heroes come to a prairie where the Laramies, a family of Pokémon Ranchers live. They learn from a daughter of the Laramie family that a race is held at the ranch once a year to measure the growth of everyone's Pokémon.

media.title: That's Just Swellow
media.description: While a competition is going on, Jessie and Meowth have been tricking Trainers into leaving their Pokémon behind for a special "relaxing" treatment. They trap the Pokémon into a net and prepare to run.
